title: Echarse a: Bursting Into an Action
goal: Use echarse a + infinitive to say that someone suddenly starts crying, laughing or running.
grammar: echarse a + infinitive: a sudden reaction

items: I can use *echarse a* + infinitive for a sudden reaction such as crying, laughing or running.
I can tell a sudden reaction (*echarse a*) from a planned task (*ponerse a*).
I can use the new words for outbursts and sudden movements.
